title: horizontalOrdinaryBaseComparison
statement: Let g:S→Y and h:T→S be scheme morphisms. On the derived QCoh categories [def-pc-derived-category] define horizontalOrdinaryBaseComparison g h:qcPullback g⋙qcPullback h≅qcPullback(h≫g) to be horizontalMateComp h g [lem-sc-horizontal-duality-mate-comparisons], with the functors written using the QCoh restriction names [lem-sc-duality-base-change-inverse-square-mate].

source.place: Remark 20.28.5 (0ATM), Remark 20.28.3 (08HY), Lemma 20.27.2 (0D5S); fixed comparisons used in Lemma 48.5.2 (0ATR)

proof.text: Use horizontalMateComp h g itself. The QCoh restriction functor names in the displayed signature are definitionally equal to the horizontal names, so no additional factors or transfer construction enter this definition.

proof_origin.place: Explicit fixed comparisons and the omitted verification of 0ATM before inversion.
